notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Dear Ladies,
In order to provide you with a better and more enjoyable game environment and experience, the server will be suspended for service maintenance and update on 25.05.2022. The whole process will last for about 60 minutes. During this period, players will not be able to log into the game. To avoid unnecessary loss, it is better to log off the game before the maintenance begins. The maintenance benefits will be issued after the maintenance.

【New Functions】
Recently, a new dim sum shop has been added to the courtyard, which is specially used to store all kinds of dim sum. And as the little guard to protect these pastries is our orange meow!
Orange Meow's new task - protect the snack shop, the more rats you kill, the more Meow coins you get~

【New Pet Furniture】
The warehouse has added furniture~
Newly added: Kitty Fleece Rug, Pink Wool Rug, Rattan Bear Bed, Berry Berry Milk Carton, Pink Paws Wheel, Dolphin Cat Tree, Banana Cat Scratcher, Musician Cat Scratcher, Barrier Cat Litter Box, Star Travel Cat Litter Box, Jade Waves Cat Bowl, Sakura Wooden Bowl.

【New Outfit】
Elegant Cheongsam, Twinkling Stars, Fawn With Flowers.

【More Outfits for Dyeing】
Purple Haze, Phoenix Auguring Well, Nile Riverbank, Ink-painted Dream, Green Lotus Clothing.
More outfits to be unlocked. Stay tuned.

【Optimization Adjustment】
1. Guild Feast preparation task shows the name of the recipient.
2. Fix some known bugs.

notes.title: 99 things that you didn’t know（31-40）
notes.content:
31. Eat a few more plates of Boiled Cabbage before imperial exam and your grades will skyrocket.
32. Matron Rong is a mysterious woman because she can make so many ladies crazy about her night after night.
33. Other men call me lady but only Prince 14th calls me by my full name all day (this is why some sisters say they want to change their name to dad?)
34. Song Wengong will call you a little fox when he just met you, anyway he was particularly charming(✿◡‿◡).
35. The heroine have a mask of the eunuch Hai.
36. Sometimes when the main storyline is fighting an archrival, the archrival is one of the partner , and then there's a situation like "I'm fighting myself".
37. The unimportant characters are always the same (e.g. the blue and green maids, the character of Empress Dowager is partner Zhen Huan).
38. When you travel, you will understand that the silver, which is usually useless, is so important.
39. Shi Lian was a gifted scholar at the Academy, she read everything and understood everything.
40. Ji Kang has exceptionally good hearing and can judge people by the sound of their footsteps.

22. Prince 14th is very popular, and most men have dealt with him.
23. Pan An is not only a gentle and elegant gentleman in appearance, but also an articulate speaker in reality.
24. Zhou Xiaoshi, Fu Heng and Prince 14th are the kings of cheesy pick-up lines.

29. Wei Jie is very good at running because he is followed by a big wave of ladies every day.
30. "Sister" Zigao's sword hasn't even slaughtered a chicken.

11. In fact, Ji Kang is a tough guy (he loves to pump iron).
12. Yinzhi likes to bathe in the lake during the day.

notes.title: 99 things that you didn’t know（1-10）
notes.content:
1. Ingot is a good thing, but you never know how it is gone.
2. The rewards for newcomers are particularly generous.
3. It is said that Wei Jie is the most difficult confidant to acquaint (many ladies said they have met many times).
4. Because Han Zigao is good-looking, the heroine always called him sister in the early stage.
5. Then sister Zigao enjoyed this treatment, until one day the heroine found that he was a man.
6. Prince 14th is actually one year younger than the heroine, but he always likes to call her elder sister.
7. Prince 14th actually has a name in history, but in "Legend of the Phoenix" he doesn't have a name.
8. Zhou Xiaoshi's age is a mystery.
9. Yinzhi is the tallest among several men. He has a height of 185 cm
10. But I know that Prince 14th is the shortest, he is an 175 cm height younger brother.

notes.title: Advanced Raiders 2
notes.content:
Debate Ranking：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/1ea32fe071cac18c0be875c318b63b8f073a7e78.png[/img]

This is a competition on increasing the points accumulated during the debate ranking, and your top eight partners with the highest stat will be randomly selected to challenge other players. There are four free chances to debate every day. After the free time are exhausted, you can use the party invitation up to 4 times to continue the debate. If you want to continue the challenge, you need to use the challenge letter. The challenge letter allows you to choose partners, and each partner can only debate once a day, so try to choose the ones with the highest stat to debate others. Players would rather challenge fewer times a day, also ensure that you can win most of their partners. So when you get a party invitation or challenge letter, it's best to focus on the debate ranking.
In short, for a beginner, you have to save your resources, especially rare resources to be ranked. Of course, you can also use your resources to do the development in order to have a comparable level with others. If you don't know what events are available, you can enter recently opened servers to check available events and prepare in advance.

Game Tips
Now I give you some game tips.
1. If you are interested in becoming a leader of a guild, remember to pay attention to the server opening time and enter early. Once entered, you need to upgrade, recharge and build a guild. Some players may think that it is unnecessary to build a guild, but if you pay attention to the sky lantern guild ranking, you can see that the guild leader's rewards are more than other guild members. Even if you are a member of the first palace, you might as well try to build a second palace yourself. The banquet invitations are very useful and are important items for your future events to fight for ranking.
2. Small banquet games
There are three mini banquet games: Throw Pot, Rock Paper Scissors and Spotlight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/4f85ac38b73a7add7460f1742efd6b87884ffda9.png[/img]

Rock Paper Scissors' outcome is unpredictable. I've already lost all my games. Throwing pot depends on your reaction. There are three pots, two large and one small. Inserting the big pot gets you 10 points, and the small for 20 points. So if we choose the small pot, you will have a maximum of 60 points. The third game is Spotlight which also depends on your reaction. You will have no pressure if respond quickly. If you shoot all the lanterns, you will have almost 50 points. but you have to be careful not to shoot the lanterns with firecrackers, and some of the lanterns with two dots should also be shot as much as possible.
In short, if you are confident, you can choose Throw Pot. If you choose to be cautious, you can choose Spotlight. If you'd rather try your luck, you can choose Rock Paper Scissors.
3. Legendary Beast Hunt. Auto-shoot lets you succeed every time, nothing more than whether it can hit a crit, so we can AKF at ease. Of course, I recommend you to AKF on the premise that no one is fighting for the first place with you, because the rewards for the 1st ranked player are better than the 2nd ranked player. Also, the hunt time returns once every two hours, so you don't need to rush to hunt, you can find a time when no one is hunting to do AFK. In the Hunting Ground, each partner can only hunt once, so you have to distribute your partners wisely. It is necessary to shoot critical hits as much as possible and reduce the number of shots. When the arrow is in the middle and a small circle appears, shooting can achieve a critical hit. If the arrow is critically hit, the output can be increased by 1.5 times, and you can complete the hunt with a partner with fewer stats than the recommended one.

notes.title: Advanced Raiders 1
notes.content:
This is an SLG-Simulation Game that you need to constantly consumes resources, so resources are very important for this kind of game. Because the amount of your resources determines the ranking of events, and the event ranking determines whether you can obtain an important recruited item. Maybe many players will say, this ranking is a matter of high VIPs, what should we fight for as a first-recharge party? Here I will introduce to the players who play without top-up how to play with resources.
Timed Ranking
The timed rankings include Partner EXP Consumption Ranking, Power Ranking, Intimacy Ranking, Fame Consumption Ranking, Banquet Ranking, Debate Ranking, etc. With so many rankings, it is impossible to compete every time. You need to accumulate and concentrate resources to get the ranking.
Partner EXP Consumption Ranking：
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/66c5113b6470867478393ec8609410ee8baccb61.png[/img]

Seeing this ranking, most players may want to save all their EXP after the ranking and wait for the next ranking. In fact, this is wrong, because EXP is a necessity for upgrading partners. Upgrading partners will increase the corresponding attributes, which will directly affect the income of each palace duty. We recommend saving the palace duty tokens for the EXP ranking. The token gives a free change for palace duty. The higher wisdom ATTR partners have, the more EXP you will get from palace duty.
Power Ranking：
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/68697f9dd3d30d2cba3f99a76cb705dd90e5cf0a.png[/img]

This ranking is based on the increase of power during the ranking period, so EXP, potential fruits, etc. are all important items. Partner level and partner's potential are important factors that affect power, so it is recommended to save some books and potential fruits. In addition, marriage can also increase power, so the marriage can also be carried out during the Power Ranking period.
Banquet Ranking:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/3bc49eb50d897f3643ce588a6ee2f58d175c2523.png[/img]

This is a competition on the points obtained during the Banquet Ranking. But you need banquet invitations to open a banquet. If you don't have enough banquet invitations, you need to spend ingots to buy them. So it's best to open fewer banquets and keep banquet invitations until ranking. There are 2 kinds of banquets, small banquets are for 5 people and large for 20 people. Banquets of 5 people have 1000 points initially. Banquets of 20 people have 5000 points initially. Opening a banquet with 20 people allows you to get a relatively higher reward. The higher the confidant’s intimacy and talent attribute, the higher the extra points you can get for holding banquets, so please choose a confidant with higher intimacy to open the banquet.

notes.title: Novice Raiders 4
notes.content:
【Debate】

There has the gameplay that PK with other players in the game, that is debating. Your partners will be sent to debate with other players' partners.
The debate condition is that after you have 8 partners, you can participate by clicking Palace - Imperial Garden. Therefore, you need to work hard to unlock partners. You can unlock partners by completing the main quest and clearing the story. The Imperial Garden is a place for partners to fight. You can buy BUFFs at the beginning and after each round of battles to increase your partner's attribute bonus or restore some HP. Don't underestimate these BUFFs, maybe they can help your partners to defeat the strong opponent in the end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/2ecd97f9eed271d51f265c9aea4bee56cc7ef913.png[/img]

After every 3 winning streak, there is a chance to flip, and the flip has a chance to obtain skill points, growth points and invitations. If you can beat 15 of the opponent's partners in a row, your name and record will be announced on the board for other players to know. The debate rule is that there are 4 random times per day by default, and you can use the invitation letter to increase the number of debates. The same partner can only be designated once a day, regardless of revenge or challenge.

【Change Outfit】
As a dress-up mobile game, dress-up is naturally the most concerned gameplay for players. On the left side of the game, there is an entrance for changing outfit. After entering, does the dazzling array of costume and jewelry confuse you? You can get most of the fashion through the exchange of cloud brocade, which can be purchased with ingots, or obtained in the spin wheel. For some rare costumes, you need to obtain fragments through the spin wheel, and then activate the complete costumes. There will be new fashions in the game from time to time, and changing clothes can satisfy your all the fantasies about dressing~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/0a5d17a7b41b2c3d629488a99b3e7698a2b77fc9.png[/img]

I hope this guide can help all the new players to avoid detours, and happy gaming~

notes.title: Novice Raiders 3
notes.content:
【Phoenix Hall】
After getting to know the confidants, every time you have a date or tryst with him, you have a chance to get a foster child. You can check your foster children in the [Phoenix Hall] - [Foster Child]. After teaching the foster children to come of age, they will participate in the imperial exam, and then they can marry the foster children of other players~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/0e2bb98c1c7873a63922206270ee2c86249c0d6a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/f5b8bd979fbf1758d77db286c732d713097a0833.png[/img]

【Pigeon Mail】
A letter can send lovesickness. Pigeon Mail is one of the game's characteristic gameplay, what should I do if my confidants are not around? At this time, you need to rely on pigeons to convey your feelings~ After improving the intimacy of confidants, you can unlock topics, and you can experience the stories with your confidants through pigeon mails every time. According to your different choices, the story will be different ending. After a sweet and ambiguous plot, you can enhance the intimacy and attributes of the confidants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/89847c03fda43ba1e02fb25aa8cfe591d845a1c3.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/1a98a5195111cda65e73f2ecc090fbf789883271.png[/img]

【Travel】
Living in the palace for a long time, it is inevitable that you will feel boring. You may wish to take a tour in your spare time. After clearing Chapter 6. Debut Show, the travel function is unlocked~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/57a0939bd243f36fa2278d13334348ada7654bcf.png[/img]

The lower right corner will display your stamina. Random travel will randomly enter the area that you have unlocked, during which various special events will be triggered, such as encountering a confidant, take some time off in a wine house, talk with people, etc.. Triggering special events can also get rare items and treasure books, and have a higher chance to meet new confidants. You can not miss it.

notes.title: Novice Raiders 2
notes.content:
After talking about the story, let’s talk about the confidant that everyone is thinking about. You can unlock the confidant when you clear Chapter 1 - Back to the Palace. After the story of a hero saving beauty, the warm-heart guardian Fu Heng was captured by you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/d9523f3c8c842c646000d1fece468255608c0938.png[/img]

After the confidant is unlocked, you can have a date with the confidants. Click on the confidant image to view the confidant's information. You can trust and gift to increase the intimacy of the confidant. When the intimacy of the confidant reaches a certain value, the skills of the corresponding bond partners can be unlocked to upgrade. As for bond points, you can tryst or date to get bond points. The higher intimacy of confidants, the more bonds you can get.
It is especially recommended for you to experience the story of the date. This is an opportunity to get close to the confidant~ On the date, your confidant and you will have various stories, and the confidants will also show their magical powers, which will make you dazzled and fascinated!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/77558990d490d2149a9a59eaa40107bfcb9b6ec6.png[/img]

notes.title: Novice Raiders 1
notes.content:
First of all, after the plot is over, you will enter the role-creation part. You can change your favorite name and face shape for the character, and then please follow the guide finger to learn how to play the game. After experiencing the change outfit, story fight, and completing the palace duties, the guide will end and you can play the game freely. It's recommended that you follow the main story quest first. The main story quest will help you to quickly familiar with all the gameplay of the game. At the same time, don't forget to complete the palace duties. On the left side of the main interface of the game, you can see the entrance of the palace duties. Click to complete the palace duties and obtain free resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/5f7077506df06375b9b3bea2d492958c5d8a0a81.png[/img]

In the early stage of the game, the cool-down time of the palace duties is very short, which is the main source of free resources for players. It is recommended that you should not forget to finish the palace duties at any time while playing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/0a6beb74571444b957edd90ee459b54ca2b137f8.png[/img]

[Story]
Next, let's talk about the story. The story is very exciting. It is a drama of palace fighting. If you love palace fighting, you can not skip the story. After the story, you will enter the battle interface, the fame and authority of the enemy will be displayed in the upper right corner, and your fame and authority will be displayed in the lower-left corner. The higher authority of yours, the less damage to your fame. You can cultivate and upgrade partners, and give partners books to improve the authority attribute, these methods can all improve the authority.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738160/e9f408c4f912759d24ff79414f865eaca5ac875b.png[/img]

After passing the five sections of the story, you will enter the battle of archrival. The archrival battle is that the partners take turns to fight against the archrival. The momentum value of the partner can be improved by upgrading the level, rewarding the books, and increasing potential. The close combat of the archrival will not consume fame.
